problems.name: Search in a Binary Search Tree
problems.question: Given the root of a binary search tree and an integer val, return the subtree rooted at the node whose value equals val, or null if the value does not exist.
problems.constraints: 1 <= number of nodes <= 5000; 1 <= Node.val <= 10000000; all values are unique; 1 <= val <= 10000000.

examples.explanation: The node with value 2 is found and its subtree is returned.
5 does not exist in the BST.

problems.optimizedComplexity: Time O(h); Space O(1). Iterative BST search follows one path.
problems.recursiveComplexity: Time O(h); Space O(h). Recursive BST search follows one path.
